user.title: Connect to Grafana Loki
user.description: Connect to Loki for log searches and alerts, and to Prometheus for ALL 1-hour and 24-hour log counters. Both servers must be accessible from Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Loki
reauth_confirm.description: Your Loki credentials were rejected. Enter the current credentials for this Loki server.

data.token: Bearer token (leave empty to keep existing)

error.invalid_configuration: Invalid URL, authentication settings, or missing credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not contact the Loki query API.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication was denied by Loki or its proxy.
error.invalid_response: Loki returned an invalid response; check the server base URL.
error.server_changed: Reauthentication must use the existing Loki URL. Use Reconfigure to change servers.
error.already_configured: That Loki URL is already configured.
error.invalid_prometheus: Prometheus URL is invalid, unreachable or the Alloy service counters are missing.

abort.already_configured: That Loki server is already configured.

settings.title: Prometheus and advanced queries
settings.description: All severity groups come from Alloy indexed labels. Prometheus provides every count. User-authored LogQL metrics poll only when explicitly enabled. Log viewing and message-based alerting remain Loki-backed.

data.poll_custom_queries: Poll custom user-authored LogQL sensors (can be expensive)

add_metric.title: Add a numeric LogQL sensor
add_metric.description: Enter a LogQL instant metric query that returns one numeric value. For example: vector(42).

select_metric.title: Choose a metric sensor to edit

edit_metric.title: Edit LogQL metric sensor
edit_metric.description: Update the query and sensor properties. The existing sensor ID is retained.

test_metric.title: Test a LogQL metric query
test_metric.description: Run the query without saving a sensor. Result: {result}

add_monitor.title: Add a host/service monitor
add_monitor.description: Create one compact host or host/service summary sensor, with 1h/24h severity counts in attributes.

edit_monitor.title: Edit host/service monitor
edit_monitor.description: The existing monitor ID and its entity history are preserved.

add_alert.title: Add a Loki alert rule
add_alert.description: Indexed Alloy severity; bounded Loki log search (at most 100 matching entries), no count_over_time. Alerts fire only on new matching messages.

data.name: Rule name
data.include_message: Include last matching log line in event (sensitive)

select_alert.title: Select an alert rule to edit

edit_alert.title: Edit a Loki alert rule
edit_alert.description: Keep the same rule ID and checkpoint. Editing the rule does not replay previously processed logs.

data.name: Rule name
data.include_message: Include last matching log line in event (sensitive)

test_alert.title: Preview a Loki alert rule
test_alert.description: Run a bounded log search without firing events. Returns up to the threshold matching logs: {count}

data.name: Rule name
data.include_message: Include last matching log line in event (sensitive)

add_hosts.title: Add multiple watched hosts
add_hosts.description: Select hosts in one operation; each gets one summary sensor. Only one integration reload.

error.invalid_labels: Label names or severity values are invalid.
error.duplicate_or_empty: Query and sensor name must be provided, and the name must be unique.
error.invalid_query: Loki did not accept the query.
error.not_numeric: The query must return a scalar or exactly one vector series. Use sum() to aggregate multiple series.
error.invalid_monitor: Enter a valid monitor name, host and optional service. Check the Loki query.
error.monitor_limit: The maximum of 64 monitors would be exceeded.
error.duplicate_monitor: A monitor with this name or host/service combination already exists.
error.duplicate_or_limit_alert: A rule with this name exists, or the maximum of 12 alert rules has been reached.
error.invalid_alert: Invalid rule or query. Alert threshold must be from 1 to 100.
error.invalid_prometheus: Prometheus URL is invalid or the API connection test failed.
error.no_hosts: No hosts found in Loki over 30 days. Add one manually or check the connection.
